sources.title: nvidia/Llama-3_1-Nemotron-Ultra-253B-CPT-v1 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Overview Llama-3.1-Nemotron-Ultra-253B-CPT-v1 is a large language model (LLM) which is a derivative of Meta Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct (AKA the parent model). This model supports a context length of 128K tokens and fits on a single 8xH100 node for inference.

sources.snippet: Llama 3.1 Nemotron Ultra 253B V1 NIM is an 253-billion-parameter multilingual large language model (LLM) pretrained and instruction tuned generative model. Developers designing AI Agent systems, chatbots, RAG systems, and other AI-powered applications can use this NIM.
